messages.text:
On Christmas night you must deliver about 2 billion presents. This weighs about 2 million tons, which is the same as 10,000 blue whales. Your sleigh must be about the size of the South Island of New Zealand. You must travel 200,000 km in 10 hours, which is 20,000 km per hour.

Invite the person in front of you to ask you any of the difficult logistical questions they may have about how you make Christmas happen. Throughout the conversation you may ask them what they think the answer is to any of the above facts. Tell them what your sleigh is made out of, how it moves so fast, what state-of-the-art machinery your toy factory uses, etc.
